Signals in Local Tools

A local tool earns trust when its behavior remains legible. The work stays on the machine, the user chooses when to act, and the resulting files are ordinary enough to inspect without special software.

Reliable capture matters because a saved page becomes part of a personal trail. The clip should keep the argument, its links, and the context needed to return to the source without carrying navigation, subscription prompts, or unrelated recommendations.

Read the implementation guide before changing a workflow that other notes already depend on.
